related_requirement_ids: REQ-OUT-007 REQ-CM-016 REQ-BRD-022 REQ-COL-027 REQ-MOD-009 REQ-SEO-024 REQ-QA-023
control_summary: Public allowlist serializer that constructs a fresh object per response and never spreads a database row
rationale: The specification prohibits exposing price and stock but names no mechanism; today the guest suppressions are scattered conditionals so a new field added upstream leaks silently
implementation: public-serialize.js consumed by every /public/* endpoint with no import path to pricing ordering or inventory modules
validation_method: Unit tests asserting the serializer output shape for every entity type
notes: Derived mechanism - the specification states the prohibition not the design

control_summary: Forbidden-key scan across /public/* responses rendered HTML inline JSON and JSON-LD
rationale: A prohibition without an automated detector is a review promise not a control
implementation: Named key denylist covering price cost stock qty warehouse customer order invoice zoho_item_id and internal label tags
validation_method: CI job failing on any occurrence in any output surface
notes: Replaces the ad hoc per-endpoint assertions implied by the old register

control_summary: Do not expose an availability boolean publicly
rationale: Across roughly 4000 SKUs a per-variant in-stock flag is scrapeable competitive intelligence even though it is not a quantity
implementation: Availability omitted from the public serializer entirely; model pages state that live inventory requires an account
validation_method: Forbidden-key scan includes the availability field
notes: Stricter than the current guest catalogue which collapses quantity to 0 or 1

control_summary: Legacy hash bridge restricted to an explicit portal route allowlist
rationale: Portal deep links use fragments which are never sent to the server so only a client-side bridge can preserve them; an unrestricted bridge would be an open redirect
implementation: Inline script on the 404 page matching a fixed list of portal route prefixes and rewriting only the host
validation_method: Security test asserting that an arbitrary or absolute-URL fragment does not redirect
notes: No source requirement covers portal link continuity

control_summary: Portal continuity verification for live sessions password-reset links and circulated shared-list links
rationale: Moving the portal off the catch-all breaks setPasswordLink and listUrl outputs already in customer inboxes
implementation: PORTAL_URL configuration applied to both link builders in the same change as the Caddy restructure
validation_method: Rehearsal on the RC host with real token and slug values before cutover
notes: Highest-scoring risk in the register

control_summary: RC host protected by basic authentication and a host-wide X-Robots-Tag noindex header
rationale: The specification requires authentication or noindex plus access controls but names no mechanism
implementation: Caddy basic_auth plus header on the RC host only
validation_method: Automated check that the RC host returns 401 or noindex

control_summary: Host-wide X-Robots-Tag noindex nofollow on the portal host
rationale: Makes the private surface non-indexable structurally rather than per-route
implementation: Caddy header on the portal host
validation_method: Header assertion test

control_summary: Placeholder token registry and build gate validated against rendered output
rationale: The specification requires placeholders removed before launch but defines no format owner or enforcement
implementation: VEY_PLACEHOLDER::<KEY> tokens plus placeholders.json with owner status and blocking flag plus check-placeholders.mjs
validation_method: Production build exits non-zero while any blocking placeholder is unresolved in rendered output
notes: Scans rendered output so database-sourced placeholders are caught too

control_summary: Omission-first content policy for optional claims
rationale: Programme ruling 13 - optional social links retailer counts MOQ lead-time and unsupported origin claims are omitted rather than shown as visible placeholders
implementation: Components render with fewer items rather than emitting placeholder text where a reader would expect a claim
validation_method: Review that no module depends structurally on a pending fact
notes: Changes the placeholder policy applied across the register

control_summary: Brand count derived from published brand records and never hard-coded
rationale: Programme ruling 7
implementation: Single query feeding homepage company page brands page and Organization schema
validation_method: Consistency test comparing every surface against the query result
notes: Current code hard-codes an eight-name PUBLIC_BRANDS array in two files

control_summary: Essedue and Kyme separation held as data configuration
rationale: Programme ruling 8
implementation: Publication flags per brand record supporting either shape without a code change
validation_method: Route generation test under both configurations

control_summary: Extreme Next unpublished by default
rationale: Programme ruling 9
implementation: Publication flag defaulting to false
validation_method: Test asserting the record is absent from published output unless explicitly flagged

control_summary: Durable submission store with a pluggable CRM adapter defaulting to none
rationale: Programme ruling 10 - CRM selection must not block implementation or production provided every submission is durably stored and operations is notified
implementation: form_submissions table written before any delivery attempt; adapter values none webhook or a named provider
validation_method: Fault-injection test proving persistence and operations alerting with the adapter disabled
notes: Makes the CRM decision configurable rather than blocking

control_summary: Analytics disabled by default behind a consent gate
rationale: Programme ruling 11
implementation: ANALYTICS_PROVIDER unset means no third-party script is emitted
validation_method: Test asserting no analytics request without consent and no request at all when unset

control_summary: Meta Pixel removed from the new public site by default
rationale: Programme ruling 12 - the existing pixel fires unconditionally with no consent gate which is defensible on an authenticated portal and not on a public marketing site
implementation: No pixel in the public application; retention becomes an explicit opt-in decision
validation_method: Scan of rendered output for the pixel identifier
notes: The pixel remains on the portal which is out of scope for this project

control_summary: Neutral presence wording for Italy Germany New York and Montreal
rationale: Programme rulings 5 and 6 - presence may be stated neutrally and a location function blocks only where a page explicitly claims one
implementation: Location records carry an optional function; templates render presence without a function until an approved value exists
validation_method: Test asserting no function label renders from an unapproved value
notes: Also resolves the source conflict between sections 9.1 and 16.1

control_summary: Publication state machine with a foreign-key approver rather than a free-text verified note
rationale: The specification requires the workflow and prohibits free-text verification but does not specify the data model
implementation: publication_state enum plus content_approvals rows plus a high-risk field list
validation_method: State-transition tests including an attempt to publish without approval

control_summary: Database trigger writing a 301 redirect row on any published slug change
rationale: The specification requires the redirect to be created or required but names no mechanism
implementation: Trigger on brands.slug and products.public_slug inserting into redirects
validation_method: Test that a slug change on a published record creates a 301

control_summary: content_updated_at column distinct from the trigger-maintained updated_at
rationale: The Zoho sync runs every thirty minutes and would otherwise churn sitemap lastmod on every product page
implementation: Separate column written only on visible content change
validation_method: Rebuild without a content change produces a byte-identical sitemap

control_summary: is_published kept independent of the existing is_active ordering flag
rationale: is_active governs orderability in the portal; conflating it with public visibility would let a Zoho deactivation silently unpublish an indexed page
implementation: New column with its own default and editorial workflow
validation_method: Test that toggling is_active does not change public route availability

control_summary: Additive-only migration policy - no existing column altered renamed or dropped
rationale: Guarantees the portal admin panel and all twenty-seven existing tests keep working and makes rollback possible without a schema revert
implementation: New tables and new columns only across migrations 0007 onward
validation_method: Existing test suite green plus a rollback rehearsal against the new schema
notes: Underpins the rollback plan

control_summary: Single indexing policy module returning robots canonical and sitemap disposition per path and query state
rationale: The specification defines the matrix but leaving it to per-template judgement guarantees drift across twenty-five routes
implementation: indexing.ts consumed by every route and by the sitemap generator
validation_method: Table-driven test covering every documented state

control_summary: Metadata builder that throws at build time when a required field is missing
rationale: Prevents an incomplete route from shipping with an empty title or canonical
implementation: seo.ts with required-field assertions
validation_method: Build failure test with a deliberately incomplete route

related_requirement_ids: REQ-SEO-019 REQ-SEO-020 REQ-SEO-021 REQ-SEO-022 REQ-SEO-023 REQ-SEO-024 REQ-SEO-025 REQ-SEO-026 REQ-SEO-027 REQ-SEO-028 REQ-SEO-029 REQ-GEO-025
control_summary: Schema-to-DOM equality test for every JSON-LD block
rationale: The specification forbids schema describing hidden or false content but names no verification method
implementation: Parser comparing each emitted value against the rendered DOM
validation_method: CI job per route

control_summary: Schema type allowlist rejecting review and rating types
rationale: Structurally prevents marking anonymous marketing copy as reviews
implementation: Allowlist enforced in the schema builder
validation_method: Unit test attempting to emit a disallowed type

control_summary: Redirect graph analysis for loops chains and destination concentration
rationale: The specification requires no loops chains or irrelevant homepage redirects but defines no threshold
implementation: Graph check plus a warning when more than twenty percent of rows target the root
validation_method: CI job over the redirects table
notes: The twenty percent threshold is an engineering judgement not a source value

control_summary: Trailing-slash canonicalisation to one form enforced in middleware
rationale: The route set uses trailing slashes throughout but the specification does not state the rule
implementation: Middleware redirect to the canonical form
validation_method: Redirect matrix test in both directions

control_summary: Fail-closed startup assertion refusing to boot the web container in production without PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN and PORTAL_ORIGIN
rationale: Mirrors the existing API startServer pattern and prevents a deploy that silently emits wrong canonicals
implementation: Startup check in the web service entrypoint
validation_method: Test asserting non-zero exit when either value is unset

control_summary: No literal production or portal hostname anywhere in the codebase
rationale: Keeps both undecided domains configurable and prevents a hard-coded canonical surviving into production
implementation: All origins read from configuration
validation_method: Source scan for candidate hostnames

control_summary: Token-diff test asserting every ported token matches the literal in the existing storefront stylesheet
rationale: The specification requires the live design be preserved but a token layer can drift silently during a port
implementation: Test comparing tokens.css values against the documented source literals
validation_method: CI job

control_summary: CSS lint rule rejecting colour literals outside the approved token set
rationale: Structurally prevents the wireframe orange and black treatment or any other accent entering the public palette
implementation: Stylelint rule
validation_method: CI job

control_summary: Every new editorial module records its derivation from the documented extension rules in a source comment
rationale: The existing homepage already documents its design decisions; keeping that habit gives reviewers something to check against other than taste
implementation: Comment convention enforced at review
validation_method: Design review checklist item

control_summary: Screenshot visual-regression suite at six breakpoints against approved baselines
rationale: The specification requires a side-by-side review but names no tooling or baseline discipline
implementation: Playwright screenshots at 1440 1280 1024 900 768 and 375
validation_method: CI job blocking on unapproved diffs
notes: Preserves the intent of old audit row REQ-EXEC-008

control_summary: Route contract suite asserting status title description canonical H1 robots and heading order for all routes
rationale: Turns the definition-of-done statement into an executable gate
implementation: Playwright request-level suite
validation_method: CI job

control_summary: Crawl suite executed with JavaScript disabled covering link validity redirects orphans and reachability
rationale: The specification requires crawlability but defines no crawl harness
implementation: Playwright crawler over the full route set
validation_method: CI job

control_summary: Automated accessibility scan across every route and breakpoint plus a manual assistive-technology pass before cutover
rationale: WCAG 2.2 AA is the stated target but the specification defines no verification harness
implementation: axe-core in Playwright plus a signed manual matrix
validation_method: CI job plus signed matrix

control_summary: Focus-ring design tokens added to a system that currently has no focus-visible style at all
rationale: The existing editorial system relies on the user-agent default which on an ivory canvas is very likely to fail focus visibility
implementation: --focus-ring and --focus-ring-dark tokens applied to every interactive element
validation_method: Automated focus-visibility check plus contrast measurement
notes: Confirmed gap in the current design not a specification omission

control_summary: Global prefers-reduced-motion guard plus a visible pause control on autoplaying media
rationale: The current homepage video autoplays with no media query and no control
implementation: Media query disabling transitions and pausing media plus a pause affordance
validation_method: Reduced-motion simulation test
notes: Confirmed gap in the current design

control_summary: Contrast measurement of every token pair in use before the visual baseline is accepted
rationale: The faint ink token at 10.5px is the most likely AA failure in the ported palette
implementation: Automated contrast check over the token matrix
validation_method: CI job

control_summary: Decide and fix the display serif - keep the platform-dependent local stack or self-host one licensed face
rationale: A platform-dependent display face cannot have a stable visual-regression baseline
implementation: Font decision recorded then implemented in the token layer
validation_method: Baseline acceptance blocked until the decision is applied
notes: Self-hosting recommended

control_summary: Lighthouse regression gate with explicit budgets plus field measurement wiring
rationale: The specification sets targets and requires field data but defines no lab gate
implementation: Lighthouse CI budgets per route
validation_method: CI job

control_summary: JavaScript bundle-size budget per route
rationale: Islands architecture makes the budget meaningful and prevents silent regression toward a heavy client bundle
implementation: Budget assertion in CI
validation_method: CI job

control_summary: Sitemap byte-identity test across a rebuild with no content change
rationale: Proves lastmod discipline mechanically rather than by inspection
implementation: Build twice and compare output
validation_method: CI job

control_summary: Form abuse and fault-injection suite covering spam rate limiting duplicate submission and delivery outage
rationale: The specification requires these to pass but defines no harness
implementation: Playwright plus injected adapter failures
validation_method: CI job

control_summary: Public forms must function with JavaScript disabled before any client enhancement is added
rationale: Guarantees lead capture survives script failure and satisfies the accessibility requirement structurally
implementation: Server-handled POST with progressive enhancement
validation_method: Submission test with scripting disabled

control_summary: Duplicate-copy detection across brand and model records
rationale: The specification forbids cloned copy but names no detector
implementation: Similarity check over published summaries stories and descriptions
validation_method: CI job reporting near-duplicates

control_summary: Shape backfill coverage threshold with an explicit ship-without-the-facet fallback
rationale: Shape data does not exist anywhere in the schema; wrong shape data on roughly thirteen hundred indexed pages is worse than a missing facet
implementation: Coverage report plus a decision gate before the facet is enabled
validation_method: Coverage report reviewed at the B4 gate
notes: Logged rather than silently truncated

control_summary: Slug generation and uniqueness verification across all catalogue records before publication
rationale: Canonical model routes cannot exist without URL-safe unique slugs and none exist today
implementation: Generation script plus a uniqueness and URL-safety assertion
validation_method: Migration test over the full catalogue

control_summary: Rollback rehearsal proving the previous Caddy layout can be restored in under ten minutes
rationale: No source requirement covers rollback; the cutover changes the catch-all that currently serves the portal
implementation: Snapshot of the working Caddyfile and compose file plus a timed restore drill
validation_method: Timed rehearsal recorded before cutover

control_summary: Sixty-second in-process cache on public catalogue reads mirroring the existing API pattern
rationale: The current catalogue shaping costs about one second per uncached request; public traffic must not scale load with page views
implementation: Cache keyed by query with invalidation on admin edit and Zoho sync
validation_method: Load test plus cache-invalidation test
notes: Reuses the proven _catalogRows and _shapedCache approach

control_summary: Public page failure policy - never render a partial commercial claim
rationale: If a claim cannot resolve its policy record the claim is omitted rather than shown unqualified
implementation: Template-level guard on every claim component
validation_method: Fault-injection test with policy lookup disabled

control_summary: Design freeze baseline archived with capture date and commit hash before any code change
rationale: The specification requires the capture but not its provenance; without a hash the baseline cannot be trusted later
implementation: Screenshots stored under the documentation tree with metadata
validation_method: Artefact review at the B0 gate

control_summary: Server-log 404 monitoring converted into redirect rows during the first ninety days
rationale: The legacy URL inventory may arrive incomplete; real traffic is the most reliable source of missing redirects
implementation: Log analysis feeding the data-driven redirects table with no deploy required
validation_method: Ninety-day review
notes: Mitigates the risk that the legacy export is late or partial

control_summary: New public application built in a separate directory rather than by refactoring the existing storefront
rationale: Two existing tests assert against the real storefront source on disk and one is an inverted guard protecting a retired homepage module
implementation: Public site lives in its own service with its own test suite; some token and markup duplication is accepted
validation_method: Existing twenty-seven tests remain green
notes: Accepted duplication is deliberate

control_summary: Remove the stale CNAME artefact at cutover
rationale: A repository CNAME file naming one of the two candidate domains is inert today but is a duplicate-domain hazard and misleads newcomers
implementation: Deleted as part of the cutover change set
validation_method: Cutover checklist item
notes: Deliberately not changed during the read-only audit phases

control_summary: Media rights and expiry as required fields on any asset used publicly
rationale: The specification lists rights and expiry as content-model fields but does not gate publication on them
implementation: Required columns on the media table with publication blocked when unset for public assets
validation_method: Publication gate test

control_summary: Mobile navigation authored as a new editorial pattern rather than reusing the portal drawer
rationale: The current header shrinks rather than collapsing and cannot hold seven primary plus three utility items on a phone
implementation: Full-height ivory overlay with focus trap and inert background
validation_method: Accessibility and responsive tests at 375 and 414
notes: No source requirement specifies the pattern only the outcome
